NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A storm is coming and someone wants to use a lavastone to turn it: try it, or prepare the ordinary way.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A huge storm is coming in from the sea. (subject) says the old stories tell of a master who turned a storm with a lavastone held high on the cliff. (friend) says the old stories also tell of the master being blown off the cliff. There is very little time. What should the village do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) climbs the cliff with the stone held high. The wind howls. The stone blazes. The storm swings away to the south and only clips the island. (subject) comes down shaking, hair standing on end. Whether it was the stone, or the wind's own mind, nobody can ever know.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village ties down the roofs, pulls up the canoes and shelters in the caves. The storm hits hard. Two huts lose their roofs. Everyone is safe. (subject) still wonders.
